desc: by address: a phone guest's app goes to the background for 20 s as Android holds it (TTYD_SYNC_BACKGROUND_AT): the host keeps its connection and place while it's away (no quiet drop), says it stepped away and is back; back in front the guest connects again at once and resumes the same session (the same player number and seat), the same progress at the end

log_must: co-op: player 2 stepped away \(their app in the background\)
net: back from the background after 20 s: connecting again at once
